keySentence: Hans got a big lump of gold.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The gold was heavy. His shoulders hurt. But he was happy. Hans got a big lump of gold.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans carried the gold on his shoulder down the road. Hans got a big lump of gold but it was terribly heavy. His shoulders ached and his legs were getting tired. He thought about his mother waiting for him at home. Even though it was hard, he smiled the whole way. Soon he would meet someone who would change everything.
facts.Word cards: traded = 교환했다 / everything = 모든 것 / horse = 말 / happy = 행복한
